newsitem.title: USA: Decor Group names D'Amore president.
newsitem.headline: Decor Group names D'Amore president.

text.p: Decor Group Inc said Monday it has appointed Dennis D'Amore to the position of president. D'Amore formerly held senior level positions with WaterJet Corp, Omniverse Inc and manufacturing divisions at Beatrice Foods and Philips Industries.
The company said Donald Feldman will no longer serve as Decor's president.
Decor also said that Donald Graves has been named vice president-sales & marketing for Artisan House Inc, a subsidiary.
